## Custom NPCs and suppliers

- Batches main-menu prefab registration and reuses movement/dialogue lookups within the registration pass. Preserves registration order and duplicate handling, falls back to individual registration after a batch failure, and retries failed cached registrations. This reduces repeated work for large NPC packs; loading-time improvements depend on the pack and environment. See [#374](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/374).
- Applies configured relationship deltas before native initialization so NPCs new to a save start at the intended relationship. Saved relationship values still take precedence. See [#376](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/376).
- Restores unlocked suppliers in Messages after loading saves with no conversation history, allowing orders without adding greeting messages or editing saves. Locked suppliers remain hidden. See [#367](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/367).

## New managed APIs

- Adds read-only vehicle seat metadata, live occupancy, managed occupants, and occupant-change notifications through `LandVehicle.Seats`. See [#371](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/371).
- Exposes item-slot lock state, immutable lock-reason snapshots, and lock, item, data, and filter events. See [#365](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/365).
- Adds read-only recycler discovery, state and hatch information, and native processing start/stop events. See [#363](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/363).

## Compatibility and validation

Targets the regular Schedule I release line supported by S1API 3.2.1. Existing public members, save identifiers, and network formats are retained; the new managed APIs are additive.

Release validation covers separate Mono and IL2CPP builds and contract suites, plus hosted documentation and API compatibility checks. This release pass does not repeat in-game or multiplayer validation. Prior feature-specific runtime evidence is recorded in the linked PRs; it does not establish live runtime coverage for every new API.
